reference_sql:
SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-06'
GROUP BY c.parent_category
alternatives: SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS n_products FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-06' GROUP BY c.parent_category

WITH covered AS (SELECT pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-06') SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM covered cv JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cv.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.parent_category
